confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Cafe and restaurant anchors are moderately solid, while July accommodation is least certain given wide peak-season rate variation. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor using typical bar price ratios because menu-level knowledge is limited. USD values assume a EUR-USD rate near 1.16 for mid-2026 and were not checked against live rates. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of the RBA latest-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned against other Western European capitals with similar cafe and restaurant price levels (for example Brussels and Vienna), with accommodation adjusted upward for Amsterdam's tight hotel supply and July peak demand. General knowledge only, no live data.
